System Design & AI Architecture Kit

Every building block, AI agent component, UI wireframe and full interview design you need on an Excalidraw board, named so you can search it and insert it with the keyboard instead of dragging boxes around.

292items22sections21full designs12agentic patterns

1. Get the file

Download system-design-ai-kit.excalidrawlib from the GitHub repo, or press Add to Excalidraw on libraries.excalidraw.com once it's listed.

2. Import once

Excalidraw: Library (book icon) > ... > Open, or drag the file onto the canvas. It stays in your browser and works on shared boards too.

3. Insert by name

Press Cmd/Ctrl + /, type kafka or tpl/ chat, press Enter. Search sd:data/ for one section.
